_meta.anti_translation_note: HE narration is written rooted-local Israeli (anchors: מרפסת ת״א, פינג'אן, פקקים). EN narration is its own original copy, not a translation.
_meta.video_prompt_language_rule: CRITICAL — When sending prompts to ANY video model (Seedance, Veo, Kling, Cinema Studio): use ONLY the `scene_anchor_en` field, NEVER `scene_anchor` (HE). Hebrew text inside video prompts causes models to hallucinate speech in Hebrew/French/random languages. HE belongs only in IG/FB/TikTok caption description (rendered natively by platform).
